title: The Mixed-Up Chameleon
author: Eric Carle

hero.name: The Mixed-Up Chameleon
hero.description: A chameleon that changes colour and shape by taking on body parts from zoo animals, ending up as a funny patchwork creature — Eric Carle collage art style
hero.source_note: Eric Carle distinctive collage-style chameleon — source from Creative Fabrica, TPT, or Eric Carle licensed clip art

ambiguous.issue: Could mean the animal or the verb 'to bear/carry'
ambiguous.reason: The chameleon wishes to be like a polar bear — animal meaning is correct

ambiguous.issue: Could mean the animal or the action of fishing
ambiguous.reason: The chameleon wishes it could swim like a fish — noun/animal meaning is correct

ambiguous.issue: Could be confused with 'dear' (homophone) when spoken aloud by a voice output device
ambiguous.reason: The chameleon wishes for antlers like a deer — animal meaning is correct

notes: Central themes are wishing to be different, changing appearance, and self-acceptance. 'Change' and 'wish' are key story verbs. The book features many zoo animals (flamingo, elephant, seal, giraffe, polar bear, fox, deer, fish, bird) — the 11 fringe words prioritise the most frequently shown and most picturable animals plus the two core story concepts (change, wish) and the emotional state (hungry) that opens and closes the narrative. 'Colors' is already listed in existing activity_images and is central to a chameleon's identity. 'Chameleon' from existing activity_images should be used; the HERO slot should use a sourced Eric Carle-style image. Secondary animals like flamingo, elephant, seal, and giraffe were omitted to keep within 11 slots — consider a supplementary board if the class focuses on specific animals.

matching.note: Min 4 approved stems, no hard cap
